posts.name: Pydro
posts.cooked: Time for a new event! For this one, the goal is to play with each person that signs up (mostly the video game, but it can be in person). Simply put you name in the first column of this sheet. If your GtG username is different than your Video Game user name, put both down with the Video Game username in parantheses. Then, a random villain will be assigned for you to play against with each other person that signs up. If you lose the game, fill the box in with red . If you win in normal mode, fill it in with green . If you win on adance, fill it in with gold . All you need to do is play a game once, but you can always try again for a better result. Good luck everyone, and have fun!

posts.name: Bowie
posts.cooked:
Got together with VisforYoshi and went four rounds.

 

We tried Advanced Spite w/3 heroes and it was not working out. We could not hurt him faster than he healed with our heroes, and it was not going well at all.

We realized it'd take forever to lose, though, so we just restarted. No screencap.

 

We tried Regular Spite w/ 5 heroes and burned him down very easily, with Ra turning all heroes immune to fire and Visionary Twisting the Ether to make all of Spite's damage fire. Beautifully simple and direct and he was down in no time.  

 

We tried Advanced Baron Blade! And... he kept himself Mobile Fortressed so long, with little damage downrange from the Freedom Four, that he managed to pull the Moon into the Earth! I have never actually seen this failure art, and I think it's pretty cool. I like it. Almost as much as I hate losing!

 

We hit Try Again and off we went! This time, we burned through every defense of his JUST in time, beating him down to flip when he would have otherwise pulled the moon down again. Surprisingly tough to outrace his Advanced discarding both times! But once he flipped, we just laid siege. It was glorious! ALL SHALL BOW BEFORE THE CITIZENS OF THE SUN!
